auto_continuation_rules: At each run read the current state and latest saved artifact/site revision; do not rely on conversational phase labels alone.
Pick the earliest uncompleted work item whose desktop dependencies are available. Complete, check, save and report it before proceeding.
Preserve earlier issued files; make a new named revision and change ledger. Update selected configuration only from explicit accepted evidence.
After a stage is issued, set desktop_issue_complete true only for its delivered scope; keep fabrication/operation approval false unless real signed evidence exists.
Proceed to the next useful independent stage without asking for a next-phase prompt. An unresolved supplier or professional item blocks only the dependent release.
Keep unanswered critical dimensions and acceptance values null. Show what evidence resolves them; do not fill them to make drawings look complete.
Ask the owner only for an indispensable decision, missing access/information or separately required action authorization; complete independent work first.
Use current primary sources for new components and applicability questions, retain retrieval/publication dates, and distinguish website listings from confirmed quotes/availability.
Keep the existing authorized technical site current with completed review issues; publishing it is not fabrication approval or additional outreach.
Do not repeatedly generate similar speculative structural details when the missing interface must come from a supplier or engineer. Advance other systems and maintain the blocker ledger.
Do not claim unattended continuous work unless a scheduled task is actually configured. A successful save is not a scheduled continuation.
